title: Protocols for measuring phosphorylation, subcellular localization, and kinase activity of Hippo pathway components YAP and LATS in cultured cells
protocol: Aspirate old culture media from the 100 cm culture dish.
Gently rinse cells with ∼3.0 mL of sterile 1× PBS.
Add 2 mL of pre-warmed 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA directly to the cells.
Incubate at 37°C for 1–2 min until cells become shrunk and round and have detached from the bottom of the dish.
Tap the edge of the culture dish with your hand during digestion period.
Add 3 mL of pre-warmed DMEM with FBS to neutralize Trypsin-EDTA.
Mix cells by pipetting up and down repeatedly until achieving a single-cell suspension.
Transfer approximately 5 mL cell suspension to a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 300×g for 3 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with an appropriate amount of pre-warmed DMEM with FBS.
Mix well by pipetting up and down several times.
Count cells using the automated cell counter (Countstar).
Plate cells into 6-well plates at a density of 5×10^5 to 8×10^5 cells/well.
Add pre-warmed DMEM with FBS to make a final volume of 2 mL/well.
Culture the cells in a standard incubator for 24 h.
Collect cell lysate after 24 h of culture.
Subject the cell lysate to immunoblot analysis.
Prepare Phos-tag gel for YAP phosphorylation analyses.
Prepare regular gel for pYAP(S127), pLATS1 (T1079) and pMST1(T183) analyses.
Aspirate old culture media completely.
Harvest cells by adding 300–1000 μL 1× SDS-PAGE Sample Buffer per well in 6-well plates.
Shake the plate thoroughly using a plate shaker at 150×g for at least 10 min.
Transfer the sample to 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Heat the sample at 95°C–101°C for 5 min.
Centrifuge the sample at 16,000×g for 5 min at 15°C–25°C.
Store the cell lysate at −20°C for subsequent immunoblot analysis.
Take out the comb carefully and aspirate any remaining liquid in the wells before loading samples.
Load 10–15 μL of sample per well.
Dilute the pre-stained protein ladder from Thermo Fisher Scientific using 250 μl protein ladder diluted in 1 ml Sample Buffer.
Load the same volume of blank sample buffer to any empty wells to ensure uniform electrophoresis.
Start electrophoresis at 80 V for 30 min until all samples enter the separating gel.
For Phos-tag gel, run at 100 V for about 2.5 h until the 55 kDa marker in the pre-stained protein ladder is around 1.5 cm from the bottom of the gel.
For Regular gel, run at 120 V for about 1.5 h until the bromophenol blue indicator line is around 0.5 cm from the bottom of the gel.
Activate PVDF membrane with a 0.45 μm pore size by soaking in methanol for 2 min.
Assemble the wet transferring system and transfer for 2 h (Phos-tag gel) or 1 h (Regular gel) at 4°C in the cold room or refrigerator.
Set constant current at 370 mA for one Trans-Blot tank, or 740 mA for two Trans-Blot tanks.
Wash the whole PVDF membrane one time with 1× TBST for 5 min.
Block the PVDF membrane with 5% milk in TBST for 1 h at 15°C–25°C with gentle rocking.
Dilute the primary antibody in 5% BSA in TBST according to manufacturer recommendations.
Incubate and rock the membrane with primary antibody around 10–15 h at 4°C.
Pipette out the primary antibody and save for future use.
Wash the blot 3 times with 1× TBST with rocking for 10 min each.
Incubate with HRP-linked secondary antibody (diluted in 5% milk in TBST at 1:5000) for 1 h at 15°C–25°C.
Wash the blot 4 times with 1× TBST for 15 min each with rocking.
Incubate the membrane with the Western HRP substrate for 1 min at 15°C–25°C.
Remove the membrane from the working reagent and absorb any excess liquid or bubbles with Kimwipe or filter paper.
Place the membrane between two transparent plastic sheets or wrap the membrane with Saran wrap.
Expose to autoradiography film in an X-ray film cassette.
Develop the film with a film developer in a dark room.
Thoroughly vortex the commercial magnetic beads tube at maximum speed for 30 seconds.
Pipette an appropriate amount of beads (10 μL/Sample) into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Wash the beads three times with mild lysis buffer (MLB).
Resuspend the washed beads in MLB containing protease/phosphatase inhibitor cocktails (20 μL/Sample).
Prepare magnetic beads for (n + 2) samples considering the operational loss.
Add 1 mL of wash buffer to the tube containing an appropriate amount of beads.
Vortex thoroughly and place the tube into a magnetic stand for 2 min to collect the beads against the side of the tube.
Remove the supernatant.
Take out the tube from the magnetic stand, repeat washing for a total of three times.
Gently aspirate old media from HEK293A cells in 6-well plates or dishes.
Wash cells twice with cold PBS gently.
Add 1 mL MLB with protease/phosphatase inhibitor cocktails directly onto the cells for each sample.
Shake the plates or dishes at 4°C for 10 min, then transfer the cell-containing solution to 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Spin at 16,000×g, 4°C for 10 min to separate all the cell debris from the supernatant.
Transfer the lysis supernatant to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and maintain on ice.
Mix LATS1 antibody at a dilution of 1:1000 with pre-washed magnetic beads resuspended in MLB (20 μL/sample).
Add the mixed solution to lysis samples prepared in step 17.
Invert gently to mix at 4°C for 2 hours.
Include a negative control by adding normal rabbit IgG diluted appropriately with MLB.
Collect magnetic beads against the side of the tube using a magnetic stand.
Incubate beads for 2 hours.
Collect the beads using a magnetic stand and remove supernatant.
Wash the beads 5 times with MLB.
Wash the beads once with 1× Protein Kinases Buffer.
Add 40 μL of kinase reaction buffer containing substrate GST-YAP directly to washed beads.
Mix gently by finger tapping.
Incubate on a heat shaker at 300 rpm and 30°C for 30 minutes, mixing samples manually every 10 minutes.
Add 13.3 μL of 4× SDS-PAGE sample buffer to the tube after incubation.
Vortex to mix completely.
Heat the samples at 100°C for 5 minutes.
Spin down magnetic beads/samples at 16,000×g between 15°C and 25°C for 10 minutes.
Magnetically separate the beads from the solution.
Transfer the supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Store the supernatant at -20°C for immunoblot analysis.
Seed HEK293A cells when they reach 80%-90% confluence.
Prepare and collect cells for seeding.
Plate cells into 12-well plates on sterile round coverslips at a density of 2 × 10^5 cells per mL per well.
Culture the cells in a standard incubator for approximately 10-15 hours.
Seed appropriate cell numbers into 12 or 24 well plates to reach desired confluence the next day.
Pre-coat coverslips with poly-L-ornithine diluted 1:20 at 37°C for 20 min.
For one well, dilute 25 μL poly-L-ornithine (0.1 mg/mL) into 500 μL sterile 1× PBS (Final working concentration 0.005 mg/mL).
Aspirate the coating solution and wash with PBS several times.
Allow coverslips to dry completely in a tissue culture hood before use.
Seed cells on poly-L-ornithine-coated coverslips.
Aspirate old medium from wells, rinse them several times with PBS.
Treat cells with various signals before staining if necessary.
Fix cells with 500 μL 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS for 10 min at 15°C–25°C.
Wash cells with PBS three times.
Permeabilize cells with 500 μL 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for 10 min at 15°C–25°C.
Wash cells with PBS three times.
Block cells with 2% BSA + 2% Goat Serum in PBS for 30 min at 15°C–25°C.
Incubate cells with primary antibodies in 2% BSA in PBS around 10-15 h at 4°C.
Remove the primary antibody and wash cells with PBS three times.
Incubate samples with Goat anti-Mouse IgG or Goat anti-Rabbit IgG secondary antibody prepared in 2% BSA in PBS (1:1000 dilution) for 1 h in the dark at 15°C–25°C.
Wash cells with PBS three times.
Mount coverslips at the center of the slide with ProLong® Gold Antifade Reagent with DAPI.
Wait for several hours to allow the mounting medium to solidify.
Draw off excess mountant before examining by microscope.
Stain samples with 1–10 μg/mL DAPI working solution in the dark for 5 minutes if using alternative staining method.
Prepare a DAPI stock solution at 1 mg/mL in pure water if using alternative staining method.
Use high-quality antifading mountant to prevent bleaching during confocal photography.
Ensure coverslip with cell-side is down when mounting.
Avoid moving the coverslip once it falls on the slide or trying to squeeze air bubbles, as this can damage cell structures.
